mechanism: Bumetanide-induced volume depletion and electrolyte abnormalities may potentiate enoxaparin's anticoagulant effects and increase bleeding risk, while loop diuretics can impair renal function affecting enoxaparin clearance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and signs of bleeding; adjust enoxaparin dosing if renal impairment develops; maintain adequate hydration and monitor INR/anticoagulation parameters.
